_comment: Matched ViT baseline for CIFAR-100, paired with configs/cifar100_dvit_5M_90epoch.json. embed_dim=192/L=12/heads=3 -> 5,380,132 params (verified), 1.06% ABOVE DepthViT's 5,323,575, so the baseline is the larger model. This is ViT-Tiny width; vit_small.py is used because it is the same architecture parameterised by width, and vit_small_trainer.py is the entry point. Tokenization is held identical to DepthViT: patch_size=4 on 32x32 -> 64 patches (+1 CLS). Optimizer, schedule, epochs, batch size, precision and seed are identical to the DepthViT config -- width is the only free variable.

trainer._comment: strategy is plain ddp: ViT has no unused parameters, unlike DepthViT's frozen-head paths. accumulate_grad_batches=1 keeps per-rank batches at 50000//512 = 97 = _steps_per_epoch().

phases.name: cls_finetune
phases._comment: 90 epochs, matching every other run in the project. warmup_steps=400: the jets configs use 5000 warmup steps at 620000/512 = 1211 steps/epoch, i.e. ~4.1 epochs of warmup. CIFAR-100 runs 50000/512 = 97 steps/epoch, so ~4.1 epochs is ~400 steps. Carrying 5000 over literally would put warmup at 51 of the 90 epochs.
